body:
raj: Hey team — embeddings suddenly dropped from 1536 -> 512 dims in prod for customer proj-astro. k-NN index returns garbage. No changes on our side. Request example below.

raj: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_org_ABC' \ 
  -H 'X-Project-ID: proj-astro' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"input":"query text"}'

raj: Response shows model: "text-embedding-3-small" and embedding length 512. We expect text-embedding-3-large (1536).

olivia: Thanks — can you paste a full request/response log (headers + body) and the project/org ids? Also, did you change SDK version or rotate keys recently?

raj: Putting sanitized logs (project/org IDs intact):

raj: REQUEST -> POST /v1/embeddings
raj: Headers: Authorization: Bearer sk_live_org_ABC, X-Org-ID: org-astro, X-Project-ID: proj-astro, User-Agent: myapp/2.0
raj: Body: {"input":"query text"}

raj: RESPONSE -> 200
raj: {"model":"text-embedding-3-small","embedding":[...512 numbers...],"usage":{...}}

olivia: Hmm — you have both X-Org-ID and X-Project-ID present. By design the API should honor project header when present and project-scoped keys. I'll triage with infra/eng.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-214. Assigned to eng-runtime.

diego: Looping in runtime — quick note: we recently patched header parsing for org-scoped keys; a side effect changed precedence when both headers are present. Looks like requests with org-scoped API keys + X-Project-ID now fall back to org default model mapping.

diego: Repro steps we used:

1) curl with Authorization: Bearer sk_live_org_ABC + X-Project-ID: proj-astro -> returned text-embedding-3-small (512)
2) curl with Authorization: Bearer sk_live_proj_ABC (project-scoped key) + X-Project-ID: proj-astro -> returned text-embedding-3-large (1536)
3) curl with Authorization: Bearer sk_live_org_ABC + X-Project-ID: proj-astro + explicit model param {"model":"text-embedding-3-large"} -> returned 1536

olivia: So current behavior: org-scoped key + project header -> uses org->default-model mapping (small), unless model explicitly specified. Project-scoped key respects project mapping.

raj: Ugh — customer uses org key for many pipelines. They never explicitly set model param. Our index expects 1536. This explains the break.

diego: Root cause: security change in header validation introduced in runtime v2.7.1 — we tightened org key validation and inadvertently deprioritized project header unless the key is project-scoped. Fix options:

- Short-term mitigation: set explicit model in embedding request: {"model":"text-embedding-3-large"}.
- Another workaround: use project-scoped API key (proj key) for requests so project mapping applies.
- Medium-term: revert precedence change or add explicit warning header/response when both org+project headers present with org key.

olivia: Can you try the explicit model param in your app and confirm? Also we'll roll a hotfix to restore previous precedence behavior and add a warning in the response when we detect ambiguous headers.

raj: Tested locally with explicit model param — returns 1536 and index is OK. Customer needs a patch deployment; ETA ~1h.

diego: Engineering action plan:
1) Patch runtime to check: if X-Project-ID present, use project mapping regardless of key scope (hotfix) — targeted deploy in next 2 hours. (PR #4876)
2) Add response header X-Redwood-Warning: "Project header ignored due to org-scoped key" temporarily until fix.
3) Add e2e tests for header precedence.

olivia: I'll notify customer and provide mitigation steps (explicit model or project-scoped key). Raj, please confirm once customer patched or if they want us to rotate a project-scoped key for them.

raj: Customer prefers us to issue a project-scoped key and we'll push a hotfix in app. Can support issue a temp project key and scope it to proj-astro?

olivia: Yes — creating a temp project key, 24h expiry. Generating now.

olivia: TEMP KEY -> sk_temp_proj_astro_XXXX (rotated after 24h). Sent to secure channel + customer.

raj: Applied temp key — embeddings now 1536 in prod. k-NN back to normal. Thanks.

diego: After hotfix deploy, we'll publish a postmortem and notify customers of the precedence bug and recommended SDK upgrade (v1.2.3+) that adds explicit header propagation.

olivia: Closing the loop: immediate customer impact mitigated. Tracking INC-2026-214 until postmortem published. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
